note: What a MUTED viewer actually reads from each shared Antidote icon, measured by blind mute tests, not intended. storyboard.js writes this into every Antidote book's rules.md. When a mute test shows an icon misread, add or sharpen its row here (book + date) so the next book's authors avoid it.

chains.neverFor: numbness, stupefaction, silenced writers, surrender to technology, links or continuity (F451 holdout1+2: 4 misreads, read as 'links' / 'history')

balance.neverFor: a critique, a reframing, a verdict on society (an empty tipped scale read as nothing, F451)

door.reads: a way in or out, exclusion

hourglass.neverFor: an epidemic, a cost, a price paid (read as 'time passing', F451)

inheritance.reads: a will, an estate, an heir

medical.neverFor: an execution, a lethal injection, an injury while fleeing, an overdose handled coldly (read as benign care, F451 x3)

coin.neverFor: a metaphorical price, cost or reckoning (read as financial debt, F451)

phone.neverFor: any world before ~2000: 1950s TV walls, radios, telephones (read as smartphone anxiety, F451)

fire.neverFor: a job described as 'cleaning' unless the fire itself is the subject

city.neverFor: a city being destroyed (it is drawn intact, F451)

target.reads: aiming at a goal, being targeted
